title: Advancing Harmful Content Detection in Organizational Research: Integrating Large Language Models with Elo Rating System

bias_targets.methodology: Detecting subtle, discriminatory, and harmful content in workplace emails using large language models combined with an Elo rating system to generate probability-based harm scores.
